none.why: Type 0 is flagged by entry_status before the table is read.

bring_object_to_area.why: unit_object set in 3320/3326 uses; the 6 unset are 3 trigger shapes in Roll The Dice (both versions), genuinely objectless. Area deliberately not required: set in 100% of uses, but whether DE reads an unset area as map-wide is unverified, so it is left to the half-set universal check.

bring_object_to_object.why: Only 3 uses, hand-judged: the condition compares two specific placed units and is meaningless without either.

own_objects.why: quantity set in 1389/1389. No any-group over object_list/object_group/object_type: the guide says those are filters, and with none set every object of the player counts.

own_fewer_objects.why: quantity set in 3415/3415. Area is optional per the guide (unset counts the whole map); object filters optional, 186 corpus uses set none.

objects_in_area.why: quantity set in 25373/25373. Object filters optional (2963 corpus uses set none). Area set in 100% but not required: an unset area may mean map-wide in DE, unverified.

destroy_object.why: unit_object set in 1384/1387; the unset ones sit in old-allies' divider trigger, genuinely empty.

capture_object.why: unit_object set in 158/158; the condition names one placed unit.

accumulate_attribute.why: quantity set in 76366/76366. attribute is not required: its vocabulary default is 0, so it could never read unset.

research_technology.why: technology's vocabulary default is 16, so it cannot be a token; source_player defaults to 1.

timer.why: timer's vocabulary default is 10, so it cannot be a token.

object_selected.why: 8 uses, all set; the condition names one placed unit.

ai_signal.why: ai_signal's vocabulary default is 0, so it cannot be a token.

player_defeated.why: source_player defaults to 1 and is never a token.

object_has_target.why: Only 2 uses, hand-judged: unit_object is the unit whose target is checked. The target side (next_object or an object filter) is optional: with none set it plausibly means any target.

object_visible.why: unit_object set in 28/28; the condition names one placed unit.

object_not_visible.why: No corpus uses; unit_object is the condition's only field, the same as object_visible.

researching_tech.why: technology's vocabulary default is 16, so it cannot be a token.

units_garrisoned.why: Only 4 uses. unit_object is the host the count is taken in. quantity left optional: under 20 uses, and -1 just makes the minimum trivially met rather than breaking it.

difficulty_level.why: quantity's per-entry DifficultyLevel presentation has a -1 member (EXTREME), so nothing is required.

chance.why: quantity (the percentage) set in 295/295; it is the condition's only field.

technology_state.why: technology defaults to 16, source_player to 1, and quantity's TechnologyState presentation has a -1 member (DISABLED).

variable_value.why: variable and comparison default to 0; quantity is set in 478/478 but -1 is a legitimate value to compare a variable against.

object_hp.why: unit_object set in 127/127. quantity (127/127) left optional: -1 is a comparable value, so requiring it could false-red a deliberate 'HP > -1'.

diplomacy_state.why: quantity's DiplomacyState presentation defaults to 0; source_player and target_player default to 1.

script_call.why: No corpus uses in the census; the condition evaluates the named XS function and does nothing without one. STR default is the empty string, which reads unset.

object_has_action.why: No corpus uses. Unit, object id and class/type are all optional filters per the guide, and unit_ai_action defaults to 0.

ai_signal_multiplayer.why: ai_signal's vocabulary default is 0, so it cannot be a token.

building_is_trading.why: No corpus uses; the condition checks one named building, its only non-bool field.

display_timer_triggered.why: No corpus uses. timer_id names the display timer; display timers are numbered from 0 (Display Timer's own timer defaults to 0), so -1 names none.

victory_timer.why: No corpus uses. victory_timer_type picks which timer to read and defaults to -1, which no VictoryTimerType member has. quantity (seconds) and comparison are left optional.

decision_triggered.why: No corpus uses, and the vocabulary gives decision_id no default; decisions are numbered from 0 (Create Decision defaults to 0), so requiring it might never fire or might false-red. decision_option defaults to 0.

object_attacked.why: No corpus uses. Unit, object id and class/type are optional filters per the guide; quantity is a minimum that -1 only makes trivial.

hero_power_cast.why: source_player defaults to 1 and is never a token.

compare_variables.why: variable, variable2 and comparison all default to 0.

trigger_active.why: Required by the plan for the get_trigger_referencing_ce types: catches a reference reset to -1 by trigger deletion. 27/29 set; the unset ones are in 8tp3w9j's begin-scenario divider trigger.

local_tech_researched.why: No corpus uses. local_technology defaults to 1197; unit and area are optional (the guide: unset area checks the whole map).

none.why: Type 0 is flagged by entry_status before the table is read.

change_diplomacy.why: diplomacy defaults to 0, source_player to 1, target_player to 2.

research_technology.why: technology's vocabulary default is 16, so it cannot be a token.

send_chat.why: Nothing required: all 224 corpus chats with no message, string id or sound hold message ' ' (Roll The Dice, both versions), a deliberate blank chat line that is_set()'s strip() reads as unset. No corpus chat has a truly empty message.

play_sound.why: sound_name set in 182/182. Location is optional: unset plays globally.

tribute.why: quantity is set in 30745/30745 but not required: negative tributes are common (about 7000, from -2 down), so -1 (take one) is a legitimate amount is_set() would read as unset. tribute_list defaults to 0, players default to 1/2.

unlock_gate.why: selected_object_ids set in 154/154; the gates to unlock are its only field.

lock_gate.why: Selected Units is the only target field (the gates to lock); with none set the effect does nothing. Set on 180/180 corpus uses.

activate_trigger.why: Plan rule: effects 8/9 require trigger_id. remove_triggers resets a reference to a deleted trigger to -1, which only this row catches.

deactivate_trigger.why: Plan rule: effects 8/9 require trigger_id. remove_triggers resets a reference to a deleted trigger to -1, which only this row catches.

ai_script_goal.why: The goal value is the only field and its vocabulary default is 1, not -1, so unset is undetectable.

create_object.why: The unit type to create and the tile to create it on; both set on 35700/35700 corpus uses. item_id is only the dropdown mirror, so it is not required.

task_object.why: Unit filters are optional (unset area means map-wide), and from 1.44 an action_type (default 0, so not a token) can task without a location: 127/1658 corpus uses have no location, 92 of them with an action.

declare_victory.why: Only source_player (default 1) and the enabled BOOL, neither a valid token.

kill_object.why: Every unit filter is optional: an unset area means the entire map and no object/class/type means all of the player's units (UGC guide), a legitimate 'kill everything' use.

remove_object.why: Every unit filter is optional (unset area = entire map, no filter = all the player's units); 30 corpus uses rely on that. object_state defaults to 2.

change_view.why: The tile to move the camera to is the effect's whole point; set on 602/602 corpus uses.

unload.why: The tile or unit to unload at (location_object_reference counts, if it resolves); set on 84/84 corpus uses. Unit filters stay optional.

change_ownership.why: Unit filters are optional (map-wide, all of the player's units) and target_player defaults to 2, so no field can be required.

patrol.why: The tile to patrol to; without it there is no patrol order. Set on 256/259 corpus uses (98.8%). Unit filters stay optional.

display_instructions.why: The instruction text, typed or from the string table (string_id replaces message). 3301 uses have a message and the other 3 a string_id. display_time and panel position default to 10 and 0.

clear_instructions.why: Only the panel position, whose default is 0, not -1.

freeze_object.why: Every unit filter is optional (unset area = entire map, no filter = all the player's units).

use_advanced_buttons.why: Deprecated since 1.36 and has no fields.

damage_object.why: The damage amount; set on 2846/2846 corpus uses. Unit filters are optional (map-wide).

place_foundation.why: The building to place and its tile; both set on 118/118 corpus uses.

change_object_name.why: Left empty on purpose: 16/1364 corpus uses set neither message nor string_id (two Roll The Dice versions), plausibly to reset the name, so requiring a name could false-red. Unit filters are optional.

change_object_hp.why: The HP amount; set on 3092/3092 corpus uses. operation defaults to 2 and unit filters are optional.

change_object_attack.why: armour_attack_quantity and armour_attack_class default to 1 and 0, operation to 3, and unit filters are optional, so nothing is requirable.

stop_object.why: Every unit filter is optional (unset area = entire map, no filter = all the player's units).

attack_move.why: Unit filters are optional, and the location is unset on 1616/1753 corpus uses (most with only an area), so it cannot be required.

change_object_armor.why: armour_attack_quantity and armour_attack_class default to 1 and 0, operation to 3, and unit filters are optional, so nothing is requirable.

change_object_range.why: The range amount; set on 225/225 corpus uses. operation defaults to 2 and unit filters are optional.

change_object_speed.why: The speed amount; set on 305/305 corpus uses. Unit filters are optional (16 uses have none, i.e. all the player's units).

heal_object.why: The HP to restore; set on 430/430 corpus uses. Unit filters are optional.

teleport_object.why: The destination tile; set on 1122/1122 corpus uses. Unit filters are optional.

change_object_stance.why: attack_stance defaults to 0 and unit filters are optional, so nothing is requirable.

display_timer.why: Left empty: every corpus use has a message or string_id, but a label-less timer may still drive Display Timer Triggered. display_time, time_unit and timer default to 10, 0 and 0.

enable/disable_object.why: The unit type to enable or disable; set on 355/355 corpus uses. item_id is only the dropdown mirror.

enable/disable_technology.why: technology defaults to 16, not -1, and item_id is only the dropdown mirror, so nothing is requirable.

change_object_cost.why: The unit type whose cost changes; set on 33/33 corpus uses. The cost fields default to 0 (1.54+) or use -1 as a real 'no cost' value (pre-1.54), so they are not required.

set_player_visibility.why: source_player, target_player and visibility_state default to 1, 2 and 0.

change_object_icon.why: The secondary object whose icon the affected units get is the effect's whole point; set on 17/17 corpus uses. Unit filters are optional.

replace_object.why: The unit type to replace with; set on 149/149 corpus uses. target_player defaults to 2 and unit filters are optional.

change_object_description.why: Left empty on purpose: 4/49 corpus uses (DDay) set neither message nor string_id, plausibly to reset the description, so requiring one could false-red.

change_player_name.why: The new name, typed or from the string table; 18/18 corpus uses have one.

change_train_location.why: The unit to move and the building that now trains it; both set on 169/169 corpus uses. button_location defaults to 0.

change_research_location.why: technology and object_list_unit_id_2 default to 16 and 82, button_location to 7, so nothing is requirable.

change_civilization_name.why: The new civilization name, typed or from the string table; 39/39 corpus uses have one.

create_garrisoned_object.why: The unit type to create inside the hosts; set on 850/850 corpus uses. The host filters are optional: 12 uses pick hosts by selected_object_ids alone.

acknowledge_ai_signal.why: Only ai_signal_value, whose default is 0, not -1.

modify_attribute.why: A slot-switching effect, so its cluster fields are never tokens; object_attributes and operation default to 0 and 1, and object_list_unit_id is unset on 61/1314 corpus uses (95%).

modify_resource.why: The amount to modify the resource by; set on 1492/1492 corpus uses. tribute_list and operation default to 0 and 1.

modify_resource_by_variable.why: tribute_list, operation and variable default to 0, 1 and 0; variable slots always exist.

set_building_gather_point.why: The gather-point tile; set on 26/26 corpus uses. Building filters are optional.

script_call.why: message holds the XS function name to call; blank calls nothing (22/22 corpus uses set it, string_id 0/22).

change_variable.why: quantity is the operand; -1 is the unset sentinel and 707/707 corpus uses set it. variable (default 0) and operation (default 1) always read as set, so they are not tokens.

change_technology_research_time.why: quantity is the new research time, the effect's only payload; -1 is the unset sentinel. technology defaults to 16 and source_player to 1, so neither can be a token. No corpus uses.

train_unit.why: the unit type to train; nothing is queued without one (8/8 corpus uses set it). Which buildings train it (selection, area or neither) and quantity are left optional.

load_key_value.why: message is the key name to load; a blank key names nothing. variable defaults to 0 so it always reads as set. No corpus uses.

store_key_value.why: message is the key name to store under; a blank key names nothing. variable defaults to 0 so it always reads as set. No corpus uses.

delete_key.why: message is the key name to delete, the effect's only field. No corpus uses.

add_train_location.why: the unit type to make trainable and the building type that gains it; with either unset there is nothing to add. Mirrors change_train_location, which sets both in 169/169 corpus uses. No corpus uses of this type itself.

build_object.why: building_list is the building to build; it is placed at the location (or a foundation via location_object_reference) or, for a wall, along the wall coordinates. The builders (selection, type, area) stay optional, since an empty filter means all of source_player's units, as on the other object-filter effects. No corpus uses.
